text:
# SEO and GEO audit: quay-store (SvelteKit)

I read all 9 tracked files. Problems are listed by severity.

## Critical

1. **Googlebot is blocked from the whole site.** `static/robots.txt:4-5` has `User-agent: Googlebot` followed by `Disallow: /`. A bot-specific group overrides the `*` group, so Google can't crawl anything. Remove the group, or change it to `Allow: /`.

2. **Client-side rendering only.** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` sets `export const ssr = false;`. The server sends an empty shell, so the `<title>`, meta description, canonical, `<h1>`, and JSON-LD only exist after JavaScript runs. Most AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) don't run JS, so they see no content at all. Google may index the pages late or incompletely. Delete the line (SSR is the default), or add `export const prerender = true;` for static pages.

## High

3. **Empty meta description on /shop.** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` has `content=""`. Write a unique 120–160 character description.

4. **The Product schema is incomplete and fragile.**
   - `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5` has only `name`. Google needs `offers` (price, priceCurrency, availability) for rich results. `image`, `description`, `sku` and `brand` are also missing.
   - The page lists several products ("Bilge pumps, cleats and rope") but declares one generic "Bilge pump". Use `ItemList` or one `Product` per item with real data.
   - Because of #2, this JSON-LD is injected client-side only, so crawlers that skip JS never see it.
   - Build it with `JSON.stringify` and escape `<`. A hand-written string inside `{@html}` is easy to break.

5. **The homepage has no structured data.** `src/routes/+page.svelte` has no `Organization` or `WebSite` JSON-LD. AI engines use these to identify the brand. Add name, url, logo and `sameAs`.

## Medium

6. **`<html>` has no `lang` attribute.** `src/app.html:2` should be `<html lang="en">`. This affects accessibility, language targeting, and AI language detection.

7. **No viewport meta tag.** `src/app.html:4` is missing `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />`. Google indexes mobile-first, so this hurts rankings.

8. **Search page title is weak.** `src/routes/search/+page.svelte:2` is just "Search". The page is correctly `noindex`. Also, `robots.txt` doesn't block `/search`, which is fine because crawlers need to fetch the page to see the `noindex`. Don't add a Disallow for it.

9. **Titles and descriptions are thin.**
   - `src/routes/+page.svelte:2` has the title "Quay: boat parts". Add a brand and a keyword, for example "Quay | Marine Boat Parts, Shipped Next Day".
   - `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:2` has "Shop all parts", which has no brand.
   - `src/routes/+page.svelte:3` has a 30-character description. Expand it.

10. **Delivery information is hidden from snippets and AI answers.** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7` wraps "Free delivery over £50." in `data-nosnippet`, so it can't appear in search snippets or AI answers. It's also a high-value fact. Remove the attribute, and consider moving the text into the page content. The text also sits after `{@render children()}`, which is odd placement for a site-wide notice.

11. **No Open Graph or Twitter tags anywhere.** Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:url`, `og:type` and `twitter:card` to the pages, ideally through a shared component.

## Low

12. **Thin content.** The home page is a single `<h1>` (`+page.svelte:7`). `/shop` is one sentence (`shop/+page.svelte:9`) with no product listing and no individual product pages. There is little for search engines or LLMs to cite. Add product pages with unique copy, specs, FAQs and delivery and returns information.

13. **Weak navigation structure.** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` has the nav as a bare `<nav>` with no `aria-label` and no `<main>` wrapper. `src/app.html:8` wraps the body in a plain `<div>`. Use `<main>` for page content and `<footer>` for the notice. Both help crawlers and AI parsers find the main content.

14. **Sitemap is minimal.** `static/sitemap.xml:3-4` has no `<lastmod>`. It's hand-maintained, so it will drift as pages are added. Generate it from the routes in a `+server.ts` endpoint.

15. **No `llms.txt`.** An `llms.txt` in `static/` (a short site summary and key URLs) is a cheap GEO addition. It isn't a standard that major engines are confirmed to use, so treat it as optional.

16. **No AI-crawler policy.** `robots.txt` doesn't address GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended. The `*` group allows them by default. Add explicit groups if you want to state a policy, and don't block them if you want AI search visibility.

17. **No favicon, no `<link rel="alternate">`, and no `hreflang`.** The £ currency suggests a UK audience. Add `hreflang="en-GB"` if you ever serve other regions.

## Priority order
Fix #1 and #2 first, because nothing else matters while Google is blocked and the content is client-rendered. Then #3–#7, which are quick wins.

I haven't changed any files. I can apply the fixes if you'd like.
